This candidate covers the forced attachment rollback path after Storage upload but before successful attachment registration/send on Web/Wasm, Android and iOS. Each route uses the shared composer/document attachment flow, leaves no pending attachment, creates no message and records Storage/DB physical residue zero.

The common PostgrestChatRepository now deletes orphan uploaded objects on register failure while preserving retry/outbox behavior for later send failures. Web/Wasm, Android legacy and iOS transports expose platform-specific Storage deletion only behind that common contract.
